svg.title: Terminal: a real OpenWiSH session on tasks/toy
svg.desc: openwish run tasks/toy/task.toml with a scripted agent finishes in 2 turns with score 1.0. openwish status shows the run state. openwish replay prints both turns: the task, the python block with save_edit, the output edit #1 saved, and the budget line python runs used 1/3.
svg.text: openwish · tasks/toy · scripted agent · real output

g.text: TASK. The network has one tensor W (2 x 2), all zeros. Make W the 2 x 2 identity matrix.
You have a Python sandbox: reply with one ```python block to run code; load(name) reads a tensor and
save_edit(name, array, reason) changes it. Reply without a code block when you are done.
save_edit('W', np.eye(2), reason='the task asks for the identity')
OUTPUT of Python run 1 of at most 3:
'edit #1 saved: 2 entries of W changed; 2 entries (50.0000%) of the network now differ from the original'
